# Excalidraw Diagram Generator Skill for Muse

Turns a plain-language description into a ready-to-open Excalidraw diagram: flowcharts, relationship diagrams, mind maps, system architecture diagrams, data flow diagrams, swimlane business flows, class diagrams, sequence diagrams, and ER diagrams — generated as `.excalidraw` JSON files that open directly in the Excalidraw app or website, where every shape stays editable. It walks through understanding your request, picking the diagram type, extracting the structured information, laying it out, validating the output against a checklist, and handing you the file with instructions to open it. Includes example prompts, troubleshooting, element-count guidelines so diagrams stay readable, and an optional icon-library workflow for richer AWS-style diagrams. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: it produces the diagram data, not a rendered image — you open the `.excalidraw` file in Excalidraw to see and edit it; diagram quality depends on how clearly you describe what to visualize; very large diagrams with icon libraries can consume significant tokens (the skill itself warns about this). skills.sh Trust Hub: unverified. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
